trace.cypher: MATCH (p:Player)-[:MentionedIn]->(:Document) WHERE p.position IN ['Frontcourt', 'Backcourt'] AND CAST(p.nba_championships AS INT64) = 0 AND CAST(p.draft_year AS INT64) > 2014 AND CAST(p.nba_championships AS INT64) <> 2 WITH p.position AS col1, MAX(CAST(p.mvp_awards AS INT64)) AS col2 RETURN col1 AS col1, col2 AS col2

MATCH (p:Player)-[:MentionedIn]->(:Document) WHERE CAST(p.nba_championships AS INT64) = 0 AND CAST(p.draft_year AS INT64) > 2014 AND p.position IS NOT NULL WITH CASE WHEN lower(p.position) IN ['center', 'power forward', 'small forward', 'forward', 'center/forward'] THEN 'Frontcourt' WHEN lower(p.position) IN ['point guard', 'shooting guard', 'guard', 'combo guard'] THEN 'Backcourt' END AS col1, CAST(p.mvp_awards AS INT64) AS mvp WHERE col1 IS NOT NULL WITH col1, MAX(mvp) AS col2 RETURN col1 AS col1, col2 AS col2

MATCH (p:Player)-[:MentionedIn]->(:Document) WHERE p.nba_championships = '0' AND p.draft_year > '2014' AND p.position IS NOT NULL WITH CASE WHEN lower(p.position) CONTAINS 'guard' THEN 'Backcourt' WHEN lower(p.position) CONTAINS 'forward' OR lower(p.position) CONTAINS 'center' THEN 'Frontcourt' END AS col1, CAST(p.mvp_awards AS INT64) AS mvp WHERE col1 IS NOT NULL WITH col1, MAX(mvp) AS col2 RETURN col1 AS col1, col2 AS col2

MATCH (p:Player)-[:MentionedIn]->(:Document) WHERE p.position IS NOT NULL AND p.nba_championships IS NOT NULL AND p.draft_year IS NOT NULL AND CAST(p.nba_championships AS INT64) = 0 AND CAST(p.nba_championships AS INT64) <> 2 AND CAST(p.draft_year AS INT64) > 2014 WITH CASE WHEN lower(p.position) CONTAINS 'guard' OR lower(p.position) IN ['g','pg','sg','backcourt'] THEN 'Backcourt' WHEN lower(p.position) CONTAINS 'forward' OR lower(p.position) CONTAINS 'center' OR lower(p.position) IN ['f','c','pf','sf','frontcourt'] THEN 'Frontcourt' END AS col1, CAST(p.mvp_awards AS INT64) AS mvp_awards WITH col1, MAX(mvp_awards) AS col2 WHERE col1 IS NOT NULL RETURN col1 AS col1, col2 AS col2
